messages:
Maya: Heads up — scheduling a maintenance window for az7 tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC. PTP sync on top-of-rack switches + NIC microcode push. We'll need rolling node drains on GPU pool-az7-1.

Josh: Thanks — what's the impact on running inference jobs? any expected job evictions?

Maya: Short term evictions during cordon/drain per-node. We'll stagger 10 nodes at a time to keep throughput. Expect 5–15% capacity reduction for ~20m windows per cohort.

Anand: Can we route tenant traffic to az8/az9 or bump dedicated pool capacity? Cost/credits question.

Sasha: We can temporarily shift some spot-backed workloads to az8 but dedicated tenants on az7 will see throttling unless we pre-warm fallback pools.

Kai: ops-oncall, can you run a quick capacity simulation? I estimated we need +120 vGPU-minutes/min across the 02:15–03:00 UTC slot.

ops-oncall: Running sim now — looks like az8 can absorb ~70% of load; remaining ~30% would need burst capacity (reserved spare) or degrade latency SLOs for non-critical requests.

Maya: Plan: stagger cohorts of 10 nodes, wait for KV cache seed on each cohort before moving on. We'll enable prefix-caching and increase batch-timeout to 40ms during the window to reduce eviction pressure.

Josh: What's the exact drain command? wanna add to playbook.

Maya: Use the safe-evac script:
```
./safe-evac --pool az7-gpu-1 --cohort 10 --wait-kvcache 300 --notify @ops-oncall
```
Will post runbook link in a sec.

infra-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az7-ptp-sync-2026

Anand: PTP sync can cause timestamp jumps; GPU driver locks might spike. Any kernel param changes?

Sasha: We'll run `ptp4l` in monitor mode first, apply microcode, then `ptp4l -f sync.conf`. Kernel `clocksource` will be preserved; we won't change `tsc` flags. If we see lockups we'll fallback NIC drivers to previous release.

Maya: Important: set autoscaler cooldown to 10m and disable scale-to-zero for az7 during window.

Kai: Noted. Also let's flag expensive reruns: if we need burst capacity, cost estimate ~+$3.2k for the 2h window (reserved GPU spot + cross-region egress). Approve?

Anand: Approve for safety. Post-ops: collect perf traces and histogram of p99 latency.

Josh: Can we add a canary cohort at 01:30 UTC (2 nodes) to validate the microcode + PTP steps? low risk.

Maya: Yes — Canary at 01:30; if canary fails we abort and rollback within 30m.

ops-oncall: I'll be on pager and will post updates to #incidents if any degradation >15%.

Sasha: Reminder: notify product teams and affected customers. I'll prepare a short blurb for status page with expected window and impact matrix.

Maya: Final checklist:
- [ ] Canary run 01:30
- [ ] Cohorts start 02:00
- [ ] KV cache seed verification
- [ ] Autoscaler cooldown tweak
- [ ] Post-window perf reports

Josh: Thanks — I'll be around for the canary.

Maya: TY team :rocket: will ping again 12h before. Any objections? Unless I hear otherwise I'll proceed with schedule.

Kai: No objections.

Anand: good.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket #MT-7223 created and linked to runbook.

Maya: Closing thread; will post final notes after canary.
